definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.34) defines class of a data item by 'the PICTURE clause, the USAGE clause, or the PICTURE and USAGE clauses'; §2023:3.33 says 'the specific clauses' and moves PICTURE/USAGE to a note. The operative table, §2002:8.5.2 Table 3, is §2023:8.5.2.1 Table 2 less the 2023-only class message-tag and category function-pointer, with the same group-item rules, so class object / category object reference is the same pair. Scope unchanged.

definition-dropped.answer: 2002 4.141 object reference 'An explicitly- or implicitly-defined data item that contains a reference to an object'; 2023 9.3.2 says the same (implicitly-defined includes the predefined references). SELF and SUPER are implicit object references in both. No change.
